WITH joined AS (
  SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e."aCL IgM"
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG("aCL IgM") as avg_val FROM joined
),
deviations AS (
  SELECT j.ID, j.SEX, j."aCL IgM", (j."aCL IgM" - oa.avg_val) as deviation
  FROM joined j
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
sex_avg_dev AS (
  SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation
  FROM deviations
  GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d."aCL IgM", d.deviation, (d.deviation - sad.avg_deviation) as diff_from_sex_avg
FROM deviations d
JOIN sex_avg_dev sad ON d.SEX = sad.SEX
WHERE d.deviation > sad.avg_deviation
ORDER BY diff_from_sex_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
